# oscilloscope-mcp - Full LLM Manifest

## Project

Name: oscilloscope-mcp
Version: 0.1.0
Path: D:/Dev/repos/oscilloscope-mcp
Author: Sandra Schipal
License: MIT
FastMCP: 3.2+
Python: 3.12+

## Purpose

Expose USB PC oscilloscopes (no built-in screen) to AI agents via MCP. The computer is the display; the USB dongle is analog frontend + ADC. Supports waveform capture, export, and measurements for electronics bring-up, MCU debug, and fleet integration with kicad-mcp and chip-design-mcp.

## Entry point

uv run python -m oscilloscope_mcp --stdio
Console script: oscilloscope-mcp

## Environment

OSCILLOSCOPE_MCP_BACKEND=auto|simulator|picoscope|hantek
OSCILLOSCOPE_MCP_CAPTURE_DIR=./captures
OSCILLOSCOPE_MCP_PORT=10936

## Tools

### scope_device
Operations: list, connect, disconnect, status, capabilities, backends
Read list/status with prefab-ui Grid+Metric cards.

### scope_configure
Operations: channel, channels, get, simulator_profile
Configure voltage range, coupling, simulator waveform (sine/square/ramp/noise).

### scope_trigger
Operations: set, get, arm, force
Trigger source channel, threshold_v, mode (auto/normal/single/off), edge (rising/falling).

### scope_capture
Operations: single, preview, export_csv, export_summary, last
Default: 100 kHz, 2000 samples. Exports to capture_dir as CSV or JSON.

### scope_measure
Operations: all, vpp, frequency, duty, rise_time, fresh
Computes metrics from last capture using numpy edge detection.

### scope_help
Operations: discover, tool_help, status, quickstart, faq, hardware_guide
Includes hardware buying guide (PicoScope 2204A recommended).

## Resources

resource://scope/capabilities
resource://scope/quickstart
resource://scope/last_capture

## Backends

1. SimulatorBackend - always on, synthetic waveforms, device_id sim-001
2. PicoScopeBackend - pyPicoSDK + PicoSDK, optional extra
3. HantekBackend - PyHT6022 + libusb, optional extra

Auto resolution order: picoscope -> hantek -> simulator

## Hardware recommendations

Best value: PicoScope 2204A (~$150), 10 MHz, pyPicoSDK
Swiss army: Analog Discovery 3 (~$300), WaveForms SDK planned
Budget: Hantek 6022BE (~$50), open-source PyHT6022

Safety: 35-50 V max on budget scopes. Never probe mains.

## Fleet

Ports: backend 10936, frontend 10937
Pairs with logic-analyzer-mcp, kicad-mcp, chip-design-mcp
Cursor mcp.json entry in docs/FLEET_INTEGRATION.md

## MCPB

- manifest.json (Claude Desktop bundle)
- just mcpb-pack → dist/oscilloscope-mcp-v0.1.0.mcpb
- glama.json for registry discovery

## PRD

docs/PRD.md — product requirements, success metrics, fleet pipelines

## Testing

uv run pytest tests/ -v -m "not integration"
Simulator tests require no hardware.

## File map

src/oscilloscope_mcp/app.py - FastMCP instance

src/oscilloscope_mcp/tools/portmanteau/ - MCP tools
src/oscilloscope_mcp/services/backends/ - drivers
docs/ - full documentation
